elevation.notes: GEDTM30 v1.2 约30m地面高程估算，65×65双线性取样；真实米制高差，不放大。用于减少建筑与植被表面干扰，仍非赛道路面、看台基础或桥隧测绘。 上海路面由原地面沿线45m高斯距离插值估算，消除原DTM无法分辨的短坡，不放大高差；非2026路面测绘。历史工程论文确认堆筑赛道约8m落差，不据此人为拉伸高程。

source.notes: Estimated road profile: periodic Gaussian distance interpolation of GEDTM30 with sigma 45m (1.5 native cells), without height rescaling or slope clipping. Engineering paper Huang et al., CJGE 35(7), 2013, Fig.15 confirms earthworks and almost 8m road relief, but is not a current road survey. Native regional ground is retained separately.
